_about: MUSIC v1 (Dom, 18 Nov): read by Scripts/Audio/MusicPlayer.cs, started from LoadingCard.Boot once the loading card is gone. tracks[]: id, file (in StreamingAssets/music/), volume (base 0..1, then times the Music slider of audio_mix.json and master), fadeInS, loop. states: which track id plays in which game state; v1 plays states.any in EVERY state (menu/camp/explore/combat/boss/death/end are placeholders, empty = not used yet). startDelayS = wait after the card is gone. loopDeclickMs = fade at the file end and start so the loop join does not click. skipArgs = command-line flags that keep it off (QA, camera scenes, fps benches); forceArg turns it on in a harness run. enabled false = silent. The WAV is streamed from disk (about 64 KB of memory), never decoded whole.
